cards.definition: xung đột, mâu thuẫn — have conflicts over/about sth (TN: harmony, agreement)
cards.example: Farmers often come into conflict with conservationists over the eagles.

cards.definition: phương pháp · methodical (adj), methodology (n)
cards.example: No single method works in every village.

cards.definition: mối đe dọa — a threat TO sth, under threat from · threaten (v)
cards.example: Illegal poisoning is a serious threat to eagles.

cards.definition: quy mô nhỏ (TN: large-scale)
cards.example: Small-scale farmers lose the most when eagles take their chickens.

cards.definition: kẻ săn mồi (TN: prey) · predatory (adj), predation (n)
cards.example: Eagles are top predators with few natural enemies.

cards.definition: động vật hoang dã (không đếm được) (TN: livestock)
cards.example: The new road is a danger to local wildlife.

cards.definition: chim săn mồi — số nhiều: birds of prey (TN: prey = con mồi)
cards.example: Eagles are birds of prey that feed on small mammals.

cards.definition: vai trò then chốt — X PLAYS a key role IN V-ing
cards.example: Eagles play a key role in controlling rats.

cards.definition: tương đối — đi với tính từ mức độ: relatively rare/cheap/accurate
cards.example: Eagle attacks on people are relatively rare.

cards.definition: sự bảo tồn · conserve (v), conservationist (n)
cards.example: Conservation efforts have doubled the eagle population.

cards.definition: kim loại — made OF metal · metallic (adj)
cards.example: The roof is made of metal.

cards.definition: dễ bị tổn thương — vulnerable TO sth · vulnerability (n) (TN: safe, protected)
cards.example: Young chickens are particularly vulnerable to eagle attacks.

cards.definition: (n) vụ mùa; (v) thu hoạch (TN v: sow, plant)
cards.example: Farmers harvest rice twice a year.

cards.definition: khả năng, phương án — possibility OF V-ing (TN: impossibility)
cards.example: They are considering the possibility of moving the power lines.

cards.definition: (1) định cư, ở lại; (2) (chim) đậu xuống · settlement (n)
cards.example: The birds settled on the roof.

cards.definition: coi, xem là — regard sb/sth AS … (consider không cần as)
cards.example: Many farmers regard eagles as pests.

cards.definition: thu nhập — a source of income (TN: expenses, expenditure)
cards.example: Chickens are the main source of income for many families.

cards.definition: doanh thu, nguồn thu — generate revenue (TN: expenditure, costs)
cards.example: Bird-watching tours generate revenue for local people.

cards.definition: làm sợ bỏ đi, xua đuổi (= frighten off) (TN: attract, lure)
cards.example: Farmers bang pots to scare away eagles.

cards.definition: nuôi, chăn nuôi (trang trọng)
cards.example: Many villagers rear chickens to earn extra money.

cards.definition: thuộc về sinh thái · ecology (n), ecologist (n), ecosystem (n)
cards.example: Eagles help to maintain the ecological balance of the area.

cards.definition: ranh giới (TN: centre, interior)
cards.example: The eagles often hunt outside the boundary of the sanctuary.

cards.definition: sinh sản, gây giống — quá khứ: bred · breeding (n), breeder (n)
cards.example: Eagles breed in the sanctuary every spring.

cards.definition: khu bảo tồn (hunting is banned — KHÔNG phải mandatory)
cards.example: Hunting is banned in protected areas.

cards.definition: đáp xuống, đậu xuống (chim, côn trùng) (TN: take off)
cards.example: The eagle alighted on a high-voltage wire.

cards.definition: xảy ra — quá khứ: occurred · occurrence (n)
cards.example: Most collisions occur near busy roads.

cards.definition: vẫn còn, vẫn là — remain + adj/n (TN: change, disappear)
cards.example: Power lines remain the biggest danger to eagles.

cards.definition: xe cộ chạy tốc độ cao (TN: slow-moving traffic)
cards.example: Eagles feeding by the road are often hit by fast-moving traffic.

cards.definition: đáng kể — khác considerate (chu đáo) (TN: negligible, minor)
cards.example: Eagles cause considerable losses to chicken farmers.

cards.definition: làm rõ điều gì bằng cách… · illustration (n)
cards.example: The speaker illustrated the problem by telling a true story.

cards.definition: hoa màu, cây trồng — crop yields (năng suất)
cards.example: Rats can destroy a large amount of crops.

cards.definition: du lịch · tourist (n) — eco-tourism, tourist attractions
cards.example: Eco-tourism brings jobs to the villages near the sanctuary.

cards.definition: bị điện giật (chết) · electrocute (v), electrocution (n) — die from electrocution
cards.example: Two eagles were electrocuted last month.

cards.definition: không có, không bị (điều tiêu cực) (TN: full of, covered with)
cards.example: Keep the area around the chicken coop free from vegetation.

cards.definition: khu bảo tồn chim
cards.example: Thousands of storks spend the winter in the bird sanctuary.

cards.definition: gây ra mối đe dọa — pose a threat TO sth (chủ ngữ số ít → poses)
cards.example: Plastic waste poses a serious threat to sea birds.

cards.definition: gây chết người — fatal TO sb · fatality (n), fatally (adv) (TN: harmless)
cards.example: That injury could be fatal.

cards.definition: đường dây điện cao áp
cards.example: Many birds die after landing on high-voltage power lines.

cards.definition: các loài chim trong danh sách bảo vệ — be among the listed birds
cards.example: It is illegal to hunt listed birds.

cards.definition: trông nom, canh chừng (TN: neglect)
cards.example: An older child is often asked to watch over the chickens.

cards.definition: tập tính săn mồi
cards.example: The predatory habits of eagles worry farmers.

cards.definition: chất độc; đầu độc · poisonous (adj), poisoning (n) — lead poisoning (TN: antidote)
cards.example: Some farmers put down poison to kill eagles.

cards.definition: sự kết hợp — a combination OF A and B (chủ ngữ số ít → is) · combine (v)
cards.example: A combination of nets and noise works best.

cards.definition: gây hại; sự tổn hại · harmful (có hại) ↔ harmless (vô hại) (TN: protect, benefit)
cards.example: The device scares the birds without harming them.

cards.definition: giải pháp thực tế — a practical solution TO + n (TN: impractical solution)
cards.example: Nets over the chicken runs are a cheap, practical solution.

cards.definition: bất hợp pháp · illegally (adv) (TN: legal, lawful)
cards.example: It is illegal to poison wild birds.

cards.definition: tổ chim; làm tổ — build a nest, nesting season
cards.example: The pair built a nest at the top of the tree.

cards.definition: vô tình, do tai nạn (TN: deliberate, intentional)
cards.example: Most eagle deaths are accidental.

cards.definition: lớn, quan trọng, nghiêm trọng — play a major role (TN: minor)
cards.example: Power lines are a major cause of eagle deaths.

cards.definition: bảo vệ khỏi · protection (n), protective (adj) (TN: endanger, expose)
cards.example: Nets can protect chickens from eagles.

cards.definition: thảm thực vật, cây cối — thick vegetation
cards.example: Thick vegetation gives rats a place to hide.

cards.definition: loài gặm nhấm — rodent control, rodent population
cards.example: Eagles keep the rodent population under control.

cards.definition: chộp, tóm lấy — seize sth in its claws, seize the day (TN: release)
cards.example: The eagle seized a chicken and flew off.

cards.definition: xét về mặt (nhớ có -s) — in terms of cost, in economic terms
cards.example: In terms of cost, this method is much cheaper.

cards.definition: phản tác dụng (TN: effective, productive)
cards.example: Killing eagles is counterproductive because the number of rats then rises.

cards.definition: xem xét, nghiên cứu (một vấn đề) (TN: ignore, overlook)
cards.example: Scientists are looking at ways to make power lines safer.

cards.definition: chỗ ẩn nấp, che chắn — take cover, run for cover, provide cover
cards.example: The chickens ran for cover when the eagle appeared.

cards.definition: môi trường sống - natural habitat, habitat loss
cards.example: clearing the forest destroys the habitat of many birds

cards.definition: dài hạn — long-term solution TO sth, in the long term (TN: short-term)
cards.example: Burying the power lines is a long-term solution.

cards.definition: ca tử vong — road fatalities, COVID-19 fatalities (TN: survivor)
cards.example: Eagle fatalities have fallen since the wires were covered.

cards.definition: ngăn không cho (không dùng avoid sb from) · prevention (n) (TN: allow, enable)
cards.example: Covering the wires prevents birds from being electrocuted.

cards.definition: xua đuổi, khiến rời đi (nhấn vào kết quả rời đi) (TN: attract)
cards.example: Shiny metal strips can drive the birds away.
